name: ShadowTune
description: ShadowTune MP3 Player firmware - dark theme library manager for ESP32
changes: NEW: Play All button (PLAY>) in every playlist/folder header - plays all songs in sequence
NEW: Shuffle toggle button (SHUF/SHUF*) in every playlist/folder header - Fisher-Yates shuffle
NEW: Per-folder shuffle persistence - each folder remembers its shuffle state across reboots (NVS sh_XXXX)
NEW: Boot state restoration - device remembers last opened folder and last played song after reboot
NEW: Play-all state persists across reboots - if play-all was active, it restores on next boot
NEW: saveBootState() called on every song play, folder change, and shuffle toggle - survives sudden power loss
Search at root level now searches ALL music across ALL folders (playlists) recursively
Search inside a playlist also searches recursively into subfolders within that playlist
Only music files can appear in search results - folders, documents, photos, system dirs are excluded
System Volume Information, $RECYCLE.BIN, lost+found, .Trashes are now filtered from playlist and search
Multi-format support: MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WMA, M4A, OPUS, MID, MIDI
BACK button on root playlist screen goes to CLOCK (time) screen
BACK button in folder goes up one level (unchanged)
LEFT joystick at root playlist also goes to CLOCK screen
Webapp accepts all music formats for upload and display
Search results show folder/track path for nested results
Defense-in-depth: isMusicExt() check before every play() call
FIX: Search result click was navigating to wrong folder due to double-indirection bug (_sortedIndex applied twice)
FIX: In-folder search now recursively searches subfolders - songs in nested folders appear in results
FIX: System Volume Information and other system folders no longer appear in playlist or search results
FIX: Long song names now word-wrap to 2 lines instead of overflowing into size column
FIX: Search matching is word-prefix only - 'pin' matches 'Pin' and 'Pink Floyd' but NOT 'pumpkin'
FIX: Stack overflow crash in searchAllMusic() - moved 25KB+ arrays to heap (malloc/PSRAM)
FIX: Added physical button support on search screen (UP/DOWN scroll results, OK play, RIGHT backspace)
FIX: Now Playing screen showed FOLDER name instead of SONG name when playing from search - _selectedEntry was stale
FIX: Clock screen now-playing overlay also showed folder name after search play - now uses _playingName
FIX: Added _playingName/_playingSize tracking - set on every play() call so correct song name always displays

apiEndpoints.GET /list: List music files [{name, size}] - recursive scan

notes.webapp: ShadowTune webapp with dark theme. 32KB single HTML embedded in PROGMEM.
notes.trash: Delete moves files to .trash/ folder on SD card. Permanent delete only via USB mass storage mode.
notes.theme: Dark theme is default. Toggle with Sun/Moon button. Persisted in localStorage.
notes.playlists: Folders on SD card root are shown as playlists. Custom playlists stored in localStorage. Each folder remembers its shuffle state (NVS sh_XXXX key).
notes.search: BOTH root and in-folder search are recursive. At root level, search scans ALL folders for music files. Inside a playlist, search scans the current folder AND all subfolders within it. Only music files appear in results. System folders (System Volume Information, $RECYCLE.BIN, etc.) are excluded. Matching is word-prefix: 'pin' matches 'Pin', 'Pink Floyd', but NOT 'pumpkin' or 'spine'.
notes.playback: Only music file types can be played: MP3, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WMA, M4A, OPUS, MID, MIDI. Folders, documents, photos are blocked. Now Playing screen always shows the correct song name even when played from search.
notes.playAll: PLAY> button starts playing all songs in the current folder. SHUF toggle enables Fisher-Yates shuffle. Both states persist per-folder in NVS. If the device is powered off during play-all, it restores the folder, song, and play-all state on next boot.
notes.bootRestore: On boot, the device navigates to the last-opened folder and selects/highlights the last-played song. If play-all was active, it is restored. This makes the device feel like it never turned off. State is saved to NVS on every song play, folder change, and shuffle toggle - so it survives sudden power loss.
notes.navigation: BACK button on root playlist screen navigates to CLOCK screen. LEFT joystick also goes to CLOCK from root.
notes.textwrap: Long song names wrap to 2 lines in playlist and search results. Size column stays on the right without overlap. If still too long, truncates with ~.
